'''Ren Auglu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] born to a family on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], Ren Auglu was handed over to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] following his father's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Taken to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Auglu underwent [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]] in an [[Clan (Jedi)/Legends|Initiate clan]] for the next several years. Before reaching the age of fourteen, [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] Auglu was selected by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ulseh]] to continue his training in the field as a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]].<ref name="OTF" />

When the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] broke out across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], Padawan Auglu was made a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and assigned to several missions. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] Auglu followed Master Ulseh to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Argul]], where they fought side by side in the [[Battle of Argul|battle]] against the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]]. During the battle, the pair oversaw the evacuation of the injured [[Argullian]]s. After an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] was shot down over the planet, Master Ulseh rushed to assist the crash victims. While Auglu survived the battle, Master Ulseh died from a droid attack on the ship's wreckage.<ref name="OTF" />

Alone on the planet with several other Padawans, Auglu continued to lead troops against the forces of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Drogen Hosh]] unsuccessfully. As Hosh prepared for a final assault, he sent Auglu and the other Padawans an offer in which he would accept their surrender. Before Hosh received a decision, however, [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] arrived on the planet with reinforcements and defeated Hosh. Victorious, Auglu and the other Padawans returned to the Jedi Temple.<ref name="OTF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Auglu made his only appearance in ''[[Only the Force]]'', a scenario for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]. In that, the player playing as Auglu can choose Auglu's sex. However, he is described as male in the biographies of the other playable characters, so that can be assumed to be his canonical sex.
